title: A data-file article's eval row is applied alone only when it can pass, or the eval-alone branch and its doc go
goal: apply_one's eval-row-alone branch for an expansion finding on a non-.md article (ql_apply.py:337) either applies the eval row when the pack passes without an expansion row, shown by a test with a real measure, or is removed with its kb/_self/querylog.md sentence, since try_fix runs only after the eval rule already failed
